item.text:
{
  "schema_version": "formalization-faithfulness-1",
  "role": "blind-translation",
  "dossier_sha256": "02847180590c8f07a6e744cc4763b19b62e19e7d734451536cb6c6c59661d085",
  "dependency_coverage": [
    {
      "id": "D001",
      "name": "LocalDef001",
      "meaning": "For a function q : ℝ → ℝ → E into a real normed vector space and a real number c, requires LocalDef003 q c x t at every pair x,t ∈ ℝ.",
      "effect_on_target": "The conditional conclusion requires the derivative existence and equation in D003 everywhere, with E = ℝ.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D002",
      "name": "LocalDef002",
      "meaning": "Given a profile f : ℝ → E and c ∈ ℝ, defines q(x,t) = f(x − ct).",
      "effect_on_target": "Specifies the exact real-valued function in both conjuncts; q is defined rather than existentially chosen.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D003",
      "name": "LocalDef003",
      "meaning": "At a specified pair (x,t), there exist qt,qx ∈ E such that τ ↦ q(x,τ) has derivative qt at t, ξ ↦ q(ξ,t) has derivative qx at x, and qt + c • qx = 0.",
      "effect_on_target": "Requires both partial derivatives to exist and satisfy ∂q/∂t + c ∂q/∂x = 0. The derivative witnesses are chosen inside the quantification over x and t.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D004",
      "name": "LocalDef004",
      "meaning": "Scalar multiplication ℝ × E → E is continuous for every real normed vector space E.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the continuity structure needed by HasDerivAt; introduces no extra hypothesis on the profile.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D005",
      "name": "And",
      "meaning": "Logical conjunction of two propositions.",
      "effect_on_target": "Both the unconditional translation identity and the conditional derivative statement hold; also joins the three requirements on derivative witnesses.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D006",
      "name": "DenselyNormedField.toNontriviallyNormedField",
      "meaning": "Retains the normed-field structure of a densely normed field and supplies nontriviality of its norm.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the scalar-field structure used for real differentiability.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D007",
      "name": "Differentiable",
      "meaning": "A function is differentiable over its scalar field at every point of its domain.",
      "effect_on_target": "The antecedent of the second conjunct is differentiability of f at every real input, without a continuous-derivative requirement.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D008",
      "name": "Eq",
      "meaning": "Equality of two elements of the same type.",
      "effect_on_target": "Both the profile identity and the zero derivative equation are exact equalities.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D009",
      "name": "HAdd.hAdd",
      "meaning": "Extracts the addition operation from a heterogeneous addition instance.",
      "effect_on_target": "With the supplied instances, forms real x + ct and addition of the derivative terms.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D010",
      "name": "HMul.hMul",
      "meaning": "Extracts the multiplication operation from a heterogeneous multiplication instance.",
      "effect_on_target": "Forms the real product ct in the shifted arguments.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D011",
      "name": "NonUnitalSeminormedCommRing.toNonUnitalSeminormedRing",
      "meaning": "Forgets commutativity from a nonunital seminormed commutative ring while retaining its operations and norm.",
      "effect_on_target": "Participates in supplying the usual real seminormed additive structure for the differentiability expression.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D012",
      "name": "NonUnitalSeminormedRing.toSeminormedAddCommGroup",
      "meaning": "Retains a nonunital seminormed ring's norm, additive commutative group, and compatible pseudometric.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the additive seminormed structure underlying the real vector-space instances.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D013",
      "name": "NormedCommRing.toSeminormedCommRing",
      "meaning": "Views a normed commutative ring as a seminormed commutative ring with the same operations, norm, and pseudometric.",
      "effect_on_target": "Changes only the available structural interface, not the real arithmetic or topology in the target.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D014",
      "name": "NormedField.toNormedSpace",
      "meaning": "Makes a normed field a normed vector space over itself using multiplication as scalar multiplication.",
      "effect_on_target": "Makes the target's real scalar action c • qx equal ordinary multiplication c qx.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D015",
      "name": "NormedSpace.toModule",
      "meaning": "Extracts the module structure of a normed vector space.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides real-linear algebra for differentiability and the scalar action in the equation.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D016",
      "name": "PseudoMetricSpace.toUniformSpace",
      "meaning": "Extracts the uniform structure of a pseudometric space.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the usual real uniform structure from which the topology for differentiability is obtained.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D017",
      "name": "Real",
      "meaning": "The type of real numbers.",
      "effect_on_target": "The profile's domain and codomain, speed, spatial and temporal variables, and derivative witnesses are all real.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D018",
      "name": "Real.denselyNormedField",
      "meaning": "Equips ℝ with its normed-field structure and the property that norms occur between any two strictly ordered positive real bounds.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the nontrivially normed scalar field required for real differentiation; places no restriction on speed.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D019",
      "name": "Real.instAdd",
      "meaning": "The real addition operation.",
      "effect_on_target": "Interprets the addition in x + ct as ordinary real addition.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D020",
      "name": "Real.instAddCommGroup",
      "meaning": "The additive commutative group structure on ℝ.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the additive algebra for the real domain, codomain, and derivative values.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D021",
      "name": "Real.instMul",
      "meaning": "The real multiplication operation.",
      "effect_on_target": "Interprets ct as ordinary real multiplication.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D022",
      "name": "Real.normedAddCommGroup",
      "meaning": "The real additive commutative group equipped with its usual norm and compatible metric.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the normed codomain required when LocalDef001 and LocalDef003 are specialized to ℝ.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D023",
      "name": "Real.normedCommRing",
      "meaning": "The usual real commutative ring with its norm and metric, satisfying the norm bound for multiplication.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides compatible arithmetic and seminormed additive structures used in the explicit differentiability type.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D024",
      "name": "Real.normedField",
      "meaning": "The usual real field equipped with its compatible metric and multiplicative norm.",
      "effect_on_target": "Fixes the scalar-field structure and the real normed vector space over itself.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D025",
      "name": "Real.pseudoMetricSpace",
      "meaning": "The pseudometric structure on ℝ with distance d(x,y) = |x − y| and the corresponding uniform structure.",
      "effect_on_target": "Ensures differentiation uses the usual topology on the real line.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D026",
      "name": "SeminormedCommRing.toNonUnitalSeminormedCommRing",
      "meaning": "Forgets the distinguished multiplicative identity while retaining a seminormed commutative ring's additive structure, multiplication, norm, and pseudometric.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies an intermediate structure in the real seminormed additive instance; adds no mathematical condition.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D027",
      "name": "UniformSpace.toTopologicalSpace",
      "meaning": "Extracts the topology carried by a uniform space.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the real topologies explicitly passed to Differentiable.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D028",
      "name": "instHAdd",
      "meaning": "Uses a type's ordinary addition as heterogeneous addition with all three types equal.",
      "effect_on_target": "Connects the displayed addition notation to the supplied real or additive-group addition.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D029",
      "name": "instHMul",
      "meaning": "Uses a type's ordinary multiplication as heterogeneous multiplication with all three types equal.",
      "effect_on_target": "Connects the displayed product ct to real multiplication.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D030",
      "name": "HSub.hSub",
      "meaning": "Extracts the subtraction operation from a heterogeneous subtraction instance.",
      "effect_on_target": "Forms the argument x − ct of the profile.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D031",
      "name": "NormedAddCommGroup",
      "meaning": "An additive commutative group equipped with a norm and compatible metric, with distance given by the norm of a difference.",
      "effect_on_target": "Constrains the generic codomain of the local derivative predicates; the actual target uses the standard real instance.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D032",
      "name": "NormedAddCommGroup.toSeminormedAddCommGroup",
      "meaning": "Retains a normed additive commutative group's norm, additive structure, and pseudometric as a seminormed additive commutative group.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the structural input required by NormedSpace and the derivative topology without changing the codomain.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D033",
      "name": "NormedSpace",
      "meaning": "A module over a normed field with a compatible norm bound for scalar multiplication.",
      "effect_on_target": "Makes the generic local predicates about real normed vector spaces; the target specializes the vector space to ℝ.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D034",
      "name": "Real.instSub",
      "meaning": "Defines real subtraction a − b as a + (−b).",
      "effect_on_target": "Fixes the negative sign of the translation in q(x,t) = f(x − ct).",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D035",
      "name": "instHSub",
      "meaning": "Uses ordinary subtraction as heterogeneous subtraction with all types equal.",
      "effect_on_target": "Connects subtraction in LocalDef002 to ordinary real subtraction.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D036",
      "name": "AddCommGroup.toDivisionAddCommMonoid",
      "meaning": "Constructs a SubtractionCommMonoid from an additive commutative group, retaining its subtraction and negation and their identities.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides inherited additive structures used to interpret zero and arithmetic in the derivative equation; does not introduce numerical division.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D037",
      "name": "AddCommMagma.toAdd",
      "meaning": "Extracts addition from a commutative additive magma.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies addition of qt and c • qx in the generic codomain.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D038",
      "name": "AddCommMonoid.toAddCommSemigroup",
      "meaning": "Retains associative and commutative addition from an additive commutative monoid.",
      "effect_on_target": "An intermediate inheritance step supplying the addition in the derivative equation.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D039",
      "name": "AddCommSemigroup.toAddCommMagma",
      "meaning": "Retains commutative addition from an additive commutative semigroup.",
      "effect_on_target": "An intermediate inheritance step connecting codomain addition to the displayed operation.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D040",
      "name": "AddMonoid.toAddZeroClass",
      "meaning": "Retains an additive monoid's addition, zero, and additive identity laws.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the additive zero structure used by the scalar action and derivative equation.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D041",
      "name": "AddZero.toZero",
      "meaning": "Extracts the zero element from a structure carrying addition and zero.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides a codomain zero used by inherited scalar-action structures.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D042",
      "name": "AddZeroClass.toAddZero",
      "meaning": "Extracts addition and zero from a structure asserting the additive identity laws.",
      "effect_on_target": "Preserves the codomain's usual additive zero through instance inheritance.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D043",
      "name": "DistribMulAction.toDistribSMul",
      "meaning": "Retains the scalar action and its preservation of zero and addition from a distributive multiplicative action.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the scalar multiplication used in c • qx.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D044",
      "name": "DistribSMul.toSMulZeroClass",
      "meaning": "Extracts scalar multiplication preserving zero from distributive scalar multiplication.",
      "effect_on_target": "An intermediate step supplying the same scalar action in the derivative equation.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D045",
      "name": "ENormedAddCommMonoid.toESeminormedAddCommMonoid",
      "meaning": "Forgets definiteness from an extended-normed additive commutative monoid while retaining its extended seminorm and additive structure.",
      "effect_on_target": "Participates in inherited codomain additive structures; introduces no extended-real variable or value into the target.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D046",
      "name": "ESeminormedAddCommMonoid.toAddCommMonoid",
      "meaning": "Extracts an additive commutative monoid from its extended-seminormed structure.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies codomain addition and zero through an inheritance path.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D047",
      "name": "ESeminormedAddCommMonoid.toESeminormedAddMonoid",
      "meaning": "Forgets commutativity from an extended-seminormed additive commutative monoid.",
      "effect_on_target": "An intermediate step obtaining codomain additive operations, without changing their values.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D048",
      "name": "ESeminormedAddMonoid.toAddMonoid",
      "meaning": "Extracts the additive monoid of an extended-seminormed additive monoid.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides inherited addition and zero for the local derivative predicate.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D049",
      "name": "Exists",
      "meaning": "Existential quantification over elements of a specified type.",
      "effect_on_target": "At each (x,t), asserts existence of qt and then qx. These real witnesses may depend on f, c, x, and t; no globally constant witnesses are required.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D050",
      "name": "HSMul.hSMul",
      "meaning": "Extracts the scalar multiplication operation from a heterogeneous scalar-action instance.",
      "effect_on_target": "Forms c • qx, which specializes to the real product c qx.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D051",
      "name": "HasDerivAt",
      "meaning": "Asserts that f has derivative f' at x, using the derivative filter with the varying argument tending to x and the base point fixed at x. For real-valued functions on ℝ, this is the ordinary derivative at x.",
      "effect_on_target": "Requires actual derivatives of both one-variable slices, with unrestricted real neighborhoods, rather than merely evaluating a derivative operator that could have a default value.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D052",
      "name": "Module.toDistribMulAction",
      "meaning": "Extracts a module's distributive action of the multiplicative scalar monoid.",
      "effect_on_target": "Connects the normed vector-space module structure to scalar multiplication in the equation.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D053",
      "name": "NegZeroClass.toZero",
      "meaning": "Extracts zero from a structure with negation fixing zero.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the additive zero that appears on the right of the derivative equation.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D054",
      "name": "NormedAddCommGroup.toAddCommGroup",
      "meaning": "Extracts the additive commutative group underlying a normed additive commutative group.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the additive group required by HasDerivAt and the local derivative equation.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D055",
      "name": "NormedAddCommGroup.toENormedAddCommMonoid",
      "meaning": "Views a normed additive commutative group as an extended-normed additive commutative monoid with its induced extended norm.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies an alternative inheritance path to the same codomain additive operations; does not enlarge the target's real codomain.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D056",
      "name": "OfNat.ofNat",
      "meaning": "Interprets a natural-number numeral in a type using its numeral instance.",
      "effect_on_target": "Interprets the displayed numeral 0 as the codomain's zero, here real zero.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D057",
      "name": "Real.instMonoid",
      "meaning": "The multiplicative monoid structure of ℝ.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the scalar monoid required by the inherited real scalar action; does not require c to be nonzero.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D058",
      "name": "Real.semiring",
      "meaning": "The semiring structure inherited from the real field.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides scalar addition and multiplication for the real module structure.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D059",
      "name": "SMulZeroClass.toSMul",
      "meaning": "Extracts scalar multiplication from a scalar-action structure preserving zero.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the operation underlying c • qx.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D060",
      "name": "SeminormedAddCommGroup.toPseudoMetricSpace",
      "meaning": "Extracts the compatible pseudometric of a seminormed additive commutative group.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the topology on the derivative codomain; for this target it is the usual real topology.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D061",
      "name": "SubNegZeroMonoid.toNegZeroClass",
      "meaning": "Retains zero, negation, and the fact that negation fixes zero from a subtraction-negation-zero monoid.",
      "effect_on_target": "An inheritance step supplying the zero in qt + c • qx = 0.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D062",
      "name": "SubtractionCommMonoid.toSubtractionMonoid",
      "meaning": "Forgets commutativity from a subtraction commutative monoid.",
      "effect_on_target": "Retains the additive operations used in the codomain's zero and subtraction structures.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D063",
      "name": "SubtractionMonoid.toSubNegZeroMonoid",
      "meaning": "Retains a subtraction monoid's subtraction and negation structure and supplies the law that negation fixes zero.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides an intermediate zero structure for the generic derivative equation.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D064",
      "name": "Zero.toOfNat0",
      "meaning": "Interprets the numeral 0 using the supplied zero element.",
      "effect_on_target": "Makes the equation's right-hand side the additive identity of E, specialized to real zero.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D065",
      "name": "instHSMul",
      "meaning": "Uses a scalar action α × β → β as heterogeneous scalar multiplication.",
      "effect_on_target": "Connects the displayed scalar multiplication to the real vector-space action.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D066",
      "name": "AddCommGroup.toAddCommMonoid",
      "meaning": "Retains addition, zero, associativity, and commutativity from an additive commutative group.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies additive monoid structures required for the module and scalar action.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D067",
      "name": "AddCommGroup.toAddGroup",
      "meaning": "Forgets commutativity from an additive commutative group.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides an inheritance path to the same addition, subtraction, negation, and zero.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D068",
      "name": "AddGroup.toSubNegMonoid",
      "meaning": "Extracts an additive group's monoid, negation, and subtraction structure.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supports the inherited codomain arithmetic used in the local derivative predicate.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D069",
      "name": "ContinuousSMul",
      "meaning": "The proposition that scalar multiplication is jointly continuous in the scalar and vector.",
      "effect_on_target": "A structural prerequisite for HasDerivAt, supplied by D004; it is not a continuity assumption about q or f.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D070",
      "name": "DivisionSemiring.toSemiring",
      "meaning": "Extracts the semiring structure from a division semiring.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the real scalar semiring through field inheritance without adding any division expression to the target.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D071",
      "name": "Field.toSemifield",
      "meaning": "Views a field as a semifield retaining its semiring and division operations.",
      "effect_on_target": "An inheritance step providing real scalar algebra; imposes no nonzero condition on speed.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D072",
      "name": "MonoidWithZero.toMonoid",
      "meaning": "Extracts the multiplicative monoid from a monoid with zero.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the scalar monoid for the module action, including zero as an allowed scalar.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D073",
      "name": "NontriviallyNormedField.toNormedField",
      "meaning": "Extracts the normed field from a nontrivially normed field.",
      "effect_on_target": "Retains the real scalar norm and field operations used in differentiation and scalar multiplication.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D074",
      "name": "NormedField.toField",
      "meaning": "Extracts the field structure underlying a normed field.",
      "effect_on_target": "Connects the real normed field to the algebraic scalar instances.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D075",
      "name": "Semifield.toDivisionSemiring",
      "meaning": "Views a semifield as a division semiring while retaining its semiring and division operations.",
      "effect_on_target": "An intermediate inheritance step for real scalar algebra with no additional proposition-level constraint.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D076",
      "name": "Semiring.toMonoidWithZero",
      "meaning": "Retains a semiring's multiplication, multiplicative identity, zero, and associated monoid-with-zero laws.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the multiplicative scalar monoid used by the real module action.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D077",
      "name": "SubNegMonoid.toAddMonoid",
      "meaning": "Extracts the additive monoid from a structure with subtraction and negation.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides inherited codomain addition and zero without altering the derivative equation.",
      "status": "understood"
    }
  ],
  "translation": {
    "binders": [
      "Universally quantify a profile f : ℝ → ℝ.",
      "Universally quantify a constant c ∈ ℝ, called speed.",
      "Define q : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ by q(x,t) = f(x − ct); q is an abbreviation for the specified construction, not an additional quantified unknown.",
      "In the first conjunct, universally quantify x,t ∈ ℝ.",
      "In the consequent of the second conjunct, universally quantify x,t ∈ ℝ, then existentially quantify qt ∈ ℝ and qx ∈ ℝ at that pair. The witnesses may depend on f, c, x, and t; qx is syntactically quantified within the scope of qt.",
      "The variables τ and ξ are real dummy arguments of the temporal and spatial slices, respectively."
    ],
    "hypotheses": [
      "There are no extra hypotheses on f or c for the first conjunct.",
      "Only the second conjunct has an antecedent: f is differentiable over ℝ at every real point.",
      "All arithmetic, norms, scalar actions, and topologies are the supplied standard real structures."
    ],
    "conclusions": [
      "For every x,t ∈ ℝ, q(x + ct,t) = f(x), equivalently f((x + ct) − ct) = f(x).",
      "If f is differentiable everywhere, then for every x,t ∈ ℝ there exist qt,qx ∈ ℝ such that the function τ ↦ f(x − cτ) has derivative qt at τ = t, the function ξ ↦ f(ξ − ct) has derivative qx at ξ = x, and qt + c qx = 0."
    ],
    "mathematical_definitions": [
      "LocalDef002 f c is the translated profile q(x,t) = f(x − ct), with spatial argument first and temporal argument second.",
      "LocalDef003 q c x t asserts existence of both ordinary partial derivatives at (x,t) together with their pointwise relation ∂q/∂t(x,t) + c ∂q/∂x(x,t) = 0.",
      "LocalDef001 q c asserts LocalDef003 q c x t for all real x and t.",
      "For a real-valued function g on ℝ, having derivative a at s means lim as h → 0 with h ≠ 0 of (g(s + h) − g(s))/h equals a.",
